points.description: States the correct term: "temporal variations" (the short-term atmospheric conditions of a place that vary from time to time are called temporal variations).
Gives the example "weather" for these short-term atmospheric conditions.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the exact term "temporal variations" and the example "weather". Each point is all or nothing. A wrong term (e.g. "climate", "spatial variations", "seasonal variations") earns nothing for P1, and a wrong example earns nothing for P2. Weather given alone without the term earns only P2.
